verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents an automations feature that runs its agent autonomously on a schedule, on repository pushes, or on connected integration events. A recent redesign adds pre-built automations for quick setup. The agent researches, plans and writes, then opens pull requests for review, and automation updates are billed per delivered result. Missing for 10: in-depth detail on configuring triggers and integrations, any independent or hands-on corroboration that background automations work as claimed, and clarity on fully unattended operation beyond PR-based human review.
